resources.string: A targeted startup resource recovery for Rain on Android 17.
Retry resource creation once if Android returns no resources while opening Rain. Normal launches remain unchanged.

Root is required to apply or restore. This uses Rain’s existing LSPatch engine; do not enable Vector injection for Rain. Changes take effect the next time Rain starts naturally; this app does not close it. Clearing Rain’s cache removes the repair; apply it again if needed.

Designed for Rain 344.13 (344013) on Android 17. Earlier native LSPatch crashes are separate and are not repaired by this module. No messages or account data are collected.
